Class binding contract (parent AND every inline child): use one class attribute per element. Convert every literal-key Vue :class object entry to its complete conditional string, preserving all keys, conditions, dependencies and static classes. For example class="task-manager {{ isDarkMode ? 'dark-theme' : '' }} {{ isCompactMode ? 'compact-mode' : '' }}". Never emit class="base {{ 'dark-theme': isDarkMode, 'compact-mode': isCompactMode }}" or class="{{ { active: flag } }}" or class="{{{ selected: condition }}}" triple-brace object syntax. San may accept only a literal prefix without reporting a compile error; compile success is not full-expression or behavior proof. Do not replace conditions with always-on class tokens. Do not guess dynamic keys, spreads or unmapped source scopes; keep unsupported cases explicit for review.
San data access rule: never destructure this.data or treat it as a plain object. Read fields separately, for example const initialGroups = this.data.get('initialGroups'), then write state with this.data.set(...). This also applies inside every inline child: if a Vue prop is named data, use this.data.get('data').map(...) and this.data.get('data').length, never this.data.map(...) or this.data.length. San initData runs before this.data exists, including in inline children: never read this.data or prop values there; return defaults and copy props into derived state in inited(), watching the prop if it can change. Computed values must be read with this.data.get('computedName'), not this.computedName. San computed callbacks do not receive the full component instance: never call this.getX() or any other component method inside computed; use pure helper functions with explicit data arguments. In every inline child template, on-* handlers must call component methods, not assign state directly: use on-mouseenter="setHoveredIndex(index)" with a method that calls this.data.set('hoveredIndex', index), never on-mouseenter="hoveredIndex = index". San this.fire(name, payload) carries one payload: do not pass separate key and value arguments. Fire {key, value} and unpack $event.key/$event.value in the parent binding. San event attributes must have a nonempty method handler. Put modifiers in the event value, for example on-submit="prevent:handleSubmit" and on-click="stop:handleClick", never on-submit.prevent or on-click.stop. For loop item and index aliases use s-for="item, index in items trackby item.id", never Vue's parenthesized (item, index) tuple. Computed entries are values, not callable formatters: when an inline child template uses formatDate(task.dueDate) or formatTrend(trend), define a top-level child method accepting that argument, not computed: { formatDate() { ... } }. Do not call Math.abs(...) directly inside inline San template interpolation; call a component method such as formatChange(change). Avoid member calls in inline child render expressions: move collection checks and string formatting into top-level child methods, passing every reactive receiver and argument explicitly. Convert Vue object-style bindings to CSS strings, for example style="{{ 'background-color: ' + insight.color + ';' }}".
Each template element must have exactly one class attribute: merge static and dynamic classes into that single attribute instead of emitting duplicate class attributes.
San s-if/s-else-if/s-for directive values use raw expressions: s-if="showSettings" and s-for="item in items trackby item.id". Never use s-if="{{showSettings}}", s-if="{= showSettings =}", or s-for="{{item in items}}".
Register Vue watchers by calling this.watch(...) directly inside San inited() or attached(). Never hide this.watch(...) inside an uncalled top-level watch() method. For an inline Vue component, migrate its complete inline_definition.source_code to const SourceName = san.defineComponent({...}) and register that exact identifier; never invent an undefined camelCase replacement. 输出要求：
1. 直接输出完整 .san 文件内容，必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段，不要输出解释或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. <script> 必须包含 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出。
3. 必须输出来自 metadata.component_name 的 name。Vue props 必须迁移为 dataTypes，并使用标准 DataTypes 类型，禁止保留 props 或 propTypes。
4. initData 必须精确保留 Vue props default 和 data() 的类型、数值、嵌套对象与数组内容；依赖 props 的内部状态应在 inited/attached 中通过 this.data.get/set 同步。
5. 状态和 computed 必须通过 this.data.get/set 访问；禁止 this.props、this.computed.foo()、this.xxx 状态访问以及直接修改嵌套对象或数组。更新嵌套状态时创建新值并写回根字段。
6. 父组件以及每一个内联子组件的 methods 都必须直接定义在各自 san.defineComponent 对象顶层，任何组件中都禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {} 包裹。Vue this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装调用必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. template 使用 San 的 on-*、s-if、s-for 语法，完整保留 DOM 结构、文本、class、子节点顺序以及方法调用的全部参数。事件参数不得丢失或改用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行。
8. Vue v-for 的循环项和索引别名必须完整迁移；:key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止独立 key 属性，也禁止写成独立 trackby="task.id" 属性。
9. {= assignable.path =} 只用于源 Vue v-model 对应的原生 input/select/textarea 可赋值路径；Vue :prop 和普通自定义组件 props 必须使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值，例如 value="{{ stat.value }}"。方法、computed、disabled、checked、selected 等派生表达式也使用 {{ ... }}，例如 disabled="{{ expression }}"，禁止 disabled="{= expression =}"。所有插值必须完整闭合。
10. value、checked、selected、disabled 等关键属性必须逐元素保留 Vue 原表达式，禁止把相邻或同级元素的条件合并进来。例如 select 的 :disabled="previewMode" 必须迁移为 disabled="{{ previewMode }}"，不能误用旁边按钮的 !canConnect || previewMode。
11. class、style、checked、selected、disabled、s-if、s-for 和文本插值调用普通方法时，响应式依赖必须出现在模板表达式中或作为参数显式传入。必须保留 SSM/Vue 表达式中的完整参数，例如 s-if="isOpen(module.id, openIds)"、s-for="lesson in visibleLessons(module.lessons, completedIds, unfinishedOnly) trackby lesson.id"。
12. 完整迁移 created/mounted/beforeDestroy/destroyed 和 watch 行为；必须把 this.watch(...) 直接放入 San inited() 或 attached()，禁止放进未被生命周期调用的普通 watch() 方法，也不能保留空钩子。
13. 复用 style_model 中的 class、selector 和 css_rules；使用 <style>，禁止 <style scoped>。不要重新设计组件或编造业务逻辑。

补充要求：保持完整 SFC、显式 DataTypes、原始样式和可直接运行的 San 代码。
